clue.text: After whisky having a go at carol singing

clue.text: Randy reveller attending second year's gathering

clue.text: Tucking into what's left, something for sticking peas?

clue.text: We find socialising only barely enjoyable

clue.text: Poor soup, i.e. spoilt with cumin

taken as written
